skill.name: testing-test-writing
skill.description: Guides AI assistants to write minimal, behavior-focused tests for core workflows, critical paths, and mocked dependencies across common test frameworks.
skill.summary: Create focused tests that verify important behavior without overfitting to implementation details.
skill.author: EIS-ITS

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a hardcoded Markdown link in SKILL.md that uses parent-directory segments to reference a testing standards document. I did not find prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or executable behavior in the scanned file.

finding_verdicts.reason: The sequence appears only in a Markdown link to a hardcoded testing standards document, not in executable code or a user-controlled filesystem operation. It may affect packaging completeness, but no arbitrary path traversal or secret access is evidenced in SKILL.md.

content.value_statement: Teams often add brittle tests that mirror implementation details instead of user behavior. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to write focused tests for critical workflows.
actual_capabilities: Identifies core user flows and critical business paths that need tests.
Promotes clear test names that describe expected behavior.
Supports unit and integration test planning for Jest, Mocha, RSpec, pytest, and JUnit.
Guides dependency mocking for APIs, databases, and file systems.
Encourages fast tests that avoid implementation details.
limitations: Does not provide runnable framework adapters or helper libraries.
Depends on the assistant understanding the project code and test framework.
May not cover exhaustive edge cases or formal coverage targets.
Referenced detailed standards may need to be available in the repository.

use_cases.title: Add Feature Tests
use_cases.description: Add focused tests after building a new workflow, with names that describe the user-visible behavior.

use_cases.title: Translate Acceptance Criteria
use_cases.description: Turn acceptance criteria into concise unit and integration tests for business-critical paths.

use_cases.title: Guide Test Reviews
use_cases.description: Set consistent testing expectations during reviews and refactors without requiring broad test rewrites.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Unit Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to write a minimal unit test for [function or component]. Focus on the main behavior and mock external dependencies.

prompt_templates.title: Cover a User Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to plan tests for [workflow]. Identify the critical path, choose coverage type, and avoid implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Brittle Tests
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review existing tests for [feature]. Suggest behavior-based names, reduce brittle assertions, and keep useful coverage.

prompt_templates.title: Design Critical Coverage
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design focused coverage for [feature]. Separate primary workflows, failure handling, mocks, fixtures, and out-of-scope tests.

output_examples.input: Request: Add tests for a checkout workflow.
output: Tests focus on successful checkout, payment failure, and cart validation.
The payment service is mocked because it is external and slow.
Assertions are moved toward rendered behavior and user actions.
Internal state checks are removed when they do not prove user value.
Mocks are reduced where real collaborators are stable and fast.

output_examples.input: Request: Choose coverage for a new API endpoint.
output: The plan covers the successful request and the main validation failure.
Database access is mocked for unit tests and exercised in one integration path.
Rare edge cases are listed as optional follow-up tests.

best_practices: Start with the primary user outcome before adding edge cases.
Mock only dependencies that make tests slow, unstable, or external.
Use test names that describe behavior in plain language.
anti_patterns: Testing private implementation details instead of observable behavior.
Adding broad edge-case suites before the core path is protected.
Using excessive mocks that hide real integration problems.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI assistants write focused tests for core workflows and critical behavior.

faq.question: Which frameworks can it support?
faq.answer: It references common frameworks such as Jest, Mocha, RSpec, pytest, and JUnit.

faq.question: Does it write complete test files?
faq.answer: It can guide complete test files when the assistant has enough project context.

faq.question: Can it help with mocking?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides when to mock APIs, databases, file systems, and other external dependencies.

faq.question: Is it useful for refactoring tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps replace brittle implementation checks with behavior-focused assertions.

faq.question: Does it guarantee full coverage?
faq.answer: No. It favors strategic coverage for important workflows over exhaustive test suites.
